title: 第5章 巡边孤站-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》
content:
第(1/3)页

    天刚蒙蒙亮，王建新就把行李捆好了。

    一个帆布包，一个网兜，里头塞着全部家当。苏和站在蒙古包门口，手里夹着烟，眼睛眯缝着看他。

    “东西都带齐了？”苏和问。

    “带齐了。”

    苏和走过来，把一个布包塞到他手里：“路上吃。”

    王建新打开一看，是奶疙瘩和几块奶干，用油纸包着，扎得紧紧的。

    “谢谢苏和大叔。”

    “谢啥。”苏和摆摆手，烟灰掉在地上，“去了那边，自己小心。狼多，夜里别往外跑。”

    “记住了。”

    “三个月送一次补给，缺啥了，记下来，到时候跟送东西的人说。”苏和顿了顿，好像还有什么话要说，最后只是挥了挥手，“实在有急事，找附近牧民捎个信。”

    王建新点点头。

    远处传来汽车的声音。一辆绿色的吉普车从土路上颠过来，停在蒙古包外面。

    车上下来两个人，一个穿军装，一个穿便服。穿军装的那个个子不高，脸晒得黝黑，走过来问：“王建新？”

    “我是。”

    “上车吧。”穿军装的说，“送你去站点。”

    王建新拎起行李，回头看了苏和一眼。

    苏和说：“去吧。”

    王建新转身上了车。车发动起来，他从后窗看出去，苏和还站在蒙古包门口，手里的烟冒着一点红光，越来越小，最后连蒙古包都看不见了。

    穿便服的那个坐在副驾驶，扭过头来：“我叫赵长青，这位是李班长。你的情况我们了解了，苏和队长推荐的，说你心细，学东西快。”

    “我会好好干。”王建新说。

    “嗯。”赵干事说，“巴特尔受伤了，他的岗位空出来。我们给你调换了一个巡边站，那个站偏是偏了点，但相对安全，铁丝网那边地势平，不容易藏人。你主要就是每天沿着线走一圈，看看网子有没有破，有没有人越界。”

    “明白了。”

    “枪会用了吧？”李班长问。

    “会了。”王建新说，“前几天培训的时候打过五十发子弹。”

    “够用就行。”李班长说，“真遇上事儿，别犹豫，开枪打。”

    车开了大半天。路越来越烂，越来越颠。两边全是草原，看不见一个人影，偶尔能看见一小群黄羊远远地跑过去，扬起一阵尘土。

    下午三点多，车停了。

    王建新下车，腿都坐麻了。眼前是一片空地，远处能看见一道山梁，灰蒙蒙的。风很大，吹得人睁不开眼。

    李班长从车上搬下来一个背包：“你的口粮，盐、调料都在里面。枪和子弹，到了站里给你。”

    王建新背上背包，拎起行李。

    “记住，每天巡逻，五十里防线，骑马走一圈。早上出发，中午回来，下午可以干点自己的活儿。”赵干事说，“三个月后我们来送补给，顺便检查工作。”

    王建新点头。

    李班长拍了拍他肩膀：“小伙子，一个人，耐住寂寞。”

    王建新站在原地，看着眼前的房子。

    房子很矮，土夯的墙，屋顶铺着干草，压了几块石头。房子旁边有个羊圈，用木棍围着，里头有十来只羊，正在低头啃地上的干草。羊圈旁边是一块菜地，大概有一亩的样子，种着东西，长得稀稀拉拉的。

    房子门口站着个人，穿着旧军装晒得黑红黑红的脸。

    王建新走过去。

    那个迎上来：“王建新？”

    “是。”

    “我是老周。”老周伸出手，手上有厚厚的老茧。

    王建新跟他握了握手。

    老周推开土坯房的门：“进来吧。”

    屋里很暗，只有一个小窗户，大概脸盆那么大。一个土炕，一个铁炉子，一口锅，一个木头柜子，一张瘸了腿的桌子，用砖头垫着。桌子上放着一个步谈机，绿色的铁盒子，上面落了一层灰。

    “就这些。”老周说，“炕能睡人，炉子能做饭，柜子放东西。步谈机，会用吧？”

    “培训的时候学过。”

    “嗯，紧急情况用。电池省着点，三个月送一次新的。”老周顿了顿，指了指外面，“外面那十只羊，是我的。菜地里的菜，也是我种的。你要留下，折个价给你。”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

At dawn, Wang Jianxin tied up his luggage.

A canvas bag and a net bag filled with all the belongings.Su He stood at the door of the yurt, holding a cigarette in his hand and looking at him with narrowed eyes.

"Have you brought everything?" Su He asked.

"We've got it all."

Su He walked over and put a cloth bag into his hand: "Eat on the road."

Wang Jianxin opened it and saw that it was a lump of milk and a few pieces of dried milk, wrapped in oil paper and tied tightly.

"Thank you, Uncle Su He."

"Thank you." Su He waved his hand and the cigarette ashes fell on the ground, "If you go over there, be careful. There are many wolves, so don't run out at night."

"Remember."

"Supplies will be delivered once every three months. If there is anything missing, write it down and tell the person who delivers it then." Su He paused, as if he had something else to say, and finally just waved his hand, "It's really urgent. Send a message to the herdsmen nearby."

Wang Jianxin nodded.

The sound of a car was heard in the distance.A green jeep came over the dirt road and parked outside the yurt.

Two people got out of the car, one in military uniform and the other in civilian clothes.The man in military uniform was short and had a tanned face. He walked over and asked, "Wang Jianxin?"

"I am."

"Get in the car." The man in military uniform said, "I'll take you to the station."

Wang Jianxin picked up his luggage and looked back at Su He.

Su He said: "Go."

Wang Jianxin turned around and got in the car.When the car started, he looked out of the rear window. Su He was still standing at the door of the yurt. The smoke in his hand was glowing red, getting smaller and smaller, and finally he couldn't even see the yurt.

The man in casual clothes was sitting in the passenger seat and turned around: "My name is Zhao Changqing, and this is Squad Leader Li. We understand your situation. Captain Su He recommended you, saying you are attentive and learn things quickly."

"I will do my best." Wang Jianxin said.

"Well." Director Zhao said, "Battle is injured, and his post is vacant. We have moved you to a border patrol station. That station is a little off, but it is relatively safe. The terrain on the other side of the barbed wire fence is flat, making it difficult to hide people. The main thing you need to do is walk along the line every day to see if the net is broken and if anyone has crossed the border."

"I understand."

"Are you able to use a gun?" Squad Leader Li asked.

"I know it." Wang Jianxin said, "I fired fifty rounds of ammunition during training a few days ago."

"It's enough." Squad Leader Li said, "If you really encounter trouble, don't hesitate to shoot."

The car drove for most of the day.The road is getting worse and worse.There were grasslands on both sides, and not a single person could be seen. Occasionally, a small group of yellow sheep could be seen running past in the distance, raising a puff of dust.

At around three o’clock in the afternoon, the car stopped.

Wang Jianxin got out of the car, his legs were numb.There was a clearing in front of him, and a gray mountain ridge could be seen in the distance.The wind was so strong that it made people unable to open their eyes.

Squad leader Li moved a backpack from the car: "Your rations, salt, and seasonings are all in it. The gun and bullets will be given to you when we arrive at the station."

Wang Jianxin put on his backpack and picked up his luggage.

"Remember, patrol every day, fifty miles of defense line, and ride a horse. Set off in the morning, come back at noon, and do some work of your own in the afternoon." Director Zhao said, "After three months, we will come to deliver supplies and inspect the work."

Wang Jianxin nodded.

Squad leader Li patted him on the shoulder: "Young man, you can endure loneliness alone."

Wang Jianxin stood there and looked at the house in front of him.

The house is very low, with rammed earth walls and a roof covered with hay and weighed with a few stones.There is a sheepfold next to the house, surrounded by wooden sticks. There are about ten sheep inside, lowering their heads and gnawing hay on the ground.Next to the sheepfold is a vegetable field, about an acre in size, growing sparsely.

There was a man standing at the door of the house, wearing an old military uniform with a tanned face.

Wang Jianxin walked over.

The one came up to him: "Wang Jianxin?"

"Yes."

"I am Lao Zhou." Lao Zhou stretched out his hand, which was covered with thick calluses.

Wang Jianxin shook hands with him.

Lao Zhou pushed open the door of the adobe house: "Come in."

The room was very dark, with only one small window, about the size of a washbasin.A clay kang, an iron stove, a pot, a wooden cabinet, and a lame table, padded with bricks.There was a walkie-talkie on the table, a green iron box with a layer of dust on it.

"That's all." Lao Zhou said, "The kang can sleep, the stove can cook, and the cabinet can store things. Do you know how to use a walkie-talkie?"

"I learned it during training."

"Yes, for emergencies. Save the battery and send a new one every three months." Old Zhou paused and pointed outside, "The ten sheep outside are mine. I also grew the vegetables in the vegetable field. If you want to keep them, I will give them to you at a discounted price."

title_en: Chapter 5: A lonely station on the border - "In the beginning of the 1970s, I made a fortune by buying goods for zero yuan"
